title: Stock policy configuration
description: The versioned stock policy of a verifier (the runner's verify kind, or `cannery evaluator` alone): declarative gates and the baseline values they compare against. Its `verifier.revision` is the revision registered in the science revision, which every verification report names as its policy revision. Cannery Row never reads this file; the verifier does.

verifier.description: The verifier service account name and this policy's revision.

baselines.description: Values of baselines, by id and revision. A gate compares against the value of the attempt's control for the gate's metric, split and slice. At most one value per baseline, metric, split and slice.

label.description: How comparisons name this baseline; defaults to `<id> <revision>`.

default_control.description: The control used when the unit names none.

baseline_measurement.description: One value of a baseline: a metric on a split, overall (no dimensions) or on a single-dimension slice.
